# AI Jungle

Human-directed, AI-executed.

AI Jungle installs and operates custom AI agent systems for owner-led firms of 5 to 50. The method is Rethink, Build, Operate, Train. Nothing ships without the owner's yes.

Start with the Leverage Assessment: three installable opportunities or it is free, and the fee comes off the first install. Installs are typically $7,500 to $15,000 fixed. Partnership is from $5,000/month plus a performance share, with a six-month minimum.

Proof: 139 qualified meetings booked in 3 months, 24% reply rate, 90 held, 0 messages without approval. Cold outreach averages a 3.4% reply rate (Instantly 2026 benchmark).

Control: every message, quote, and post waits in one approval ledger in Telegram until the owner approves it. Client data stays in a private, secured environment with no lock-in.
